title: SecFlow Workflow Graph Contract (React Flow <-> GraphQL <-> Orchestrator)
description: Canonical DAG representation shared by Next.js @xyflow/react, edge-gateway, orchestrator, ★1 Template Library, and ★3 AIService.GenerateWorkflow. Enforces ADR-0004 (strict Trigger -> Source -> ... separation, explicit output port handles, and zero raw secrets in params).

pluginId.description: Must match an active built-in or registered external PluginManifest.plugin_id.

params.description: Validated against PluginManifest.params_json_schema (canonical built-in schemas in node-params.schema.json). String fields in source.git, notify.*, mcp.tool, report.export may use safe {{ $trigger.* | $envelope.* | $ai.* | $run.* }} expressions. Raw secrets are FORBIDDEN here.

secretBindings.description: Explicit mapping of logical secret param keys to SecretStore secret_ref IDs. Identical wire shape across protojson (repeated SecretBinding), JSON Schema, and GraphQL. Stripped automatically on Template publish/clone and always empty in ★3 GenerateWorkflow output.

sourceHandle.description: Must match a PortDefinition.id declared in the source plugin's output_ports (e.g. default, true, false, match, nomatch, CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM_LOW, SECRET, SAST, SCA, CLEAN, PASS, WARN, FAIL).
